motivation: Use Wikidata's documented stable Special:EntityData first-party JSON with content SHA256 and returned revision id, rather than replaying the overloaded wbgetentities API's maxlag failure. Independent CC0 fact/association source, not Qwen activation coordinate mapping.
rights: Only first-party Wikidata structured QID/PID labels and unqualified statement triples; Wikidata structured data CC0; do not include Wikipedia text or contributor-only other data.
authority: QTR source-only isolated draft development and one-shot public Actions; no accepted model or source changes elsewhere.

selection.endpoint_order: ascending numeric QID from source seed unqualified nondeprecated allowed-property QID claims, not using source labels or heldout outcomes

custody_requirements: Wikidata first-party HTTPS, strict host/path, redirect only to whitelisted same host
One bounded source fetch per ID, SHA256 exact raw JSON and record lastrevid; no retry, no change to frozen source items and predicates
Verify returned JSON `entities` has exactly the requested entity ID, no missing/redirect/cross-ID; positive integer lastrevid, and meaningful English label
For each seed ID, also verify revision-addressed JSON ?revision=<returned lastrevid> has same entity ID/revision and equivalent canonical entity JSON SHA256; any mismatch blocks admission
Read only eligible and witnessed source Q-P-Q edges; exclude qualified, deprecated, missing labels and non-first-party IDs, never invent semantics from indices

Source snapshot canonical UTF-8 JSON with Q/P semantic labels, claim witnesses and seed/endpoint/property raw SHA256 and revisions and full archive SHA256; retain in run-specific GitHub Actions artifact only
Independent numeric uint32 triple carrier canonical restored byte-exact, source-informed symbolic retrieval/two-hop exact parity
No assertion that symbolic graph is learned general knowledge, causal reasoning, or more efficient than conventional controls

roles.source_seed: unqualified first-party statements and subject labels
roles.endpoint: independent English object labels only, not training outcome
roles.control: same-triple symbolic set exact answer and two-hop
roles.negative: shuffled edge, malformed first-party witness, missing label, cross-ID/revision drift and altered numeric snapshot fail closed

admission: One or more semantically labeled, first-party witnessed Q-P-Q triples with exact raw-source receipts and seed revision canonical reread equality; no science pass.
stop: If source unavailable, challenge, rate-limited, revision mismatched, redirect off-host, response too large or zero admissible triples, record SOURCE_BLOCKED without alternate source or altered budgets. Do not treat source-free unit success as successful source capture.
